subject: [hw] IP -> lead: review items implemented - exit 70 on guest stop, KeepAlive plist, RWVC_DMA_INFO rev 2, cease-serve test
body:
Both items are implemented and tested.

1) Guest stop is now fatal: daemon/vcodecd.c answers the pending/owning request with N2VCD_E_GUEST + numeric detail, sends seq-0 E_GUEST to every other client that has sent traffic, logs one bounded `N2VCD ... fatal guest stop session=.. code=.. reason=..` line (the reason text carries the pc/address; there is no n2elf_describe accessor in host/n2vhost.h), drops VENC/VENC_C1 power refs raw (does not enter the AP close path against a dead guest), and `_exit(70)`. open/ENC_SET/force-key/encode/watchdog all take that path. A hardware timeout (-ETIMEDOUT from V41) stays non-fatal and the daemon keeps serving. install/com.nord2.vcodecd.plist now has RunAtLoad true, `--gate /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec-run`, KeepAlive {SuccessfulExit:false}, ThrottleInterval 10. Host test: a request-time guest stop and a watchdog stop each exit 70; a second connected client gets seq-0 E_GUEST; green in ASan/UBSan, -O2 and TSan.

2) RWVC_DMA_INFO rev 2 is used for real: daemon/n2vcd_srv.c wraps the ioctl; vcodecd re-queries each client handle, registers pa-only with V41, detects a reused handle with a different pa, and forgets on change/session end. P03 also wrapped it; header rev 2 compiled cleanly for iOS and the product still links.

Suite: bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 722/722; bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK, vcodecd 254208 B, n2vcd_cli 69952 B, both linked. STATUS/LAYOUT updated.
